releaseNotes.headline: What’s New shows once
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.13 stops the What’s New window from reappearing every time you open Settings.

highlights.title: Settings opens Settings
highlights.detail: Opening Settings no longer brings back the What’s New window once you have seen it; it stays available from the usAIge menu.

highlights.title: Drag tools into order
highlights.detail: Drag tool rows in Manage AI Tools to set their order in the rail; a tool’s limits stay grouped together.

highlights.title: The rail shows every tool
highlights.detail: The floating rail grows to fit all of your tools instead of scrolling.
